CASE 07-JD-0119 / COLD CASE DIVISION

Some faces have to be rebuilt before they can be remembered.

A first-person horror investigation game about facial reconstruction and identifying unsolved cases. Explore the scene, recover physical evidence, and rebuild an unidentified victim's face by hand.

Two roles, one case

Investigator

Walks the scene

Explores the scene in first person and recovers what was left behind. Brings evidence back to the sculptor to finish the case.

Artist

Rebuilds the face

Takes the evidence and reconstructs a face by hand, one decision at a time. A wrong guess keeps the case cold. Play solo as both roles, or split the work with a partner in local co-op.

●

Built-in Twitch integration

Viewers can trigger chaos events that disrupt the investigation in real time.

Get notified at launch

Leave your email to hear about the demo, the Steam page, and launch day as soon as they are public. No spam.
